summary: Equinor ASA, a Norwegian energy firm reporting on Form 6-K, disclosed share repurchases under the third tranche of its 2026 buy-back programme. Between 24-28 August 2026, it acquired 720,516 own shares at an average price of NOK 388.0749 per share, totalling NOK 279.6 million. The tranche, announced 22 July 2026, runs to 26 October 2026. Post-transaction, Equinor holds 18,103,431 shares (0.76% of capital), including share-savings shares; excluding these, it owns 0.30%. Purchases occurred on Oslo Børs and alternative venues. Watch for continued programme pace and any adjustments given Norwegian disclosure rules.
